recommendation: Provide outreach and psychoeducation for substance use disorders
implementation_steps: Deliver psychoeducation about substance use disorders and treatment options
Provide motivational enhancement through personalized feedback
Support treatment engagement through outreach and navigation assistance
Address social determinants of health affecting treatment access and success
Connect patients to community resources and support systems
evidence_summary: CHW-led outreach and psychoeducation interventions have demonstrated improvements in treatment engagement and outcomes for substance use disorders, particularly in underserved communities with limited access to traditional healthcare services.
